# Suspect Showdown: SoR Revan (KingofBlades) vs Reborn Krayt (ILS), Suspect Insight
URL: https://www.suspectinsightforums.com/t4450-ss-revan-kingofblades-vs-darth-krayt-ils (linked by Crimson in NJO #general 2026-10-18 4:55 AM EDT)
Raw: forum-raw/t4450.html / t4450.txt. Fetched 2026-10-18 (quick skim, not a full read). Only page 1 fetched; no judge verdict visible on it.
Setup (June 2022): in character, morals on, 424 m apart, Lothal plains arena. Revan as of SWTOR Shadow of Revan; Krayt as of Legacy: War.

## KingofBlades (Revan)
- Leans on Saga/WotC stats: Sith Showdown (Darth Revan UTF 24 vs Krayt 22-23), Galactic Files (Darth Revan = Reborn Krayt), KOTOR/Legacy Campaign Guides; chains via Exar Kun and Traya.
- Argues Darth Revan > Vong Krayt is the "last known reference point", so SoR Revan (stronger than Darth Revan after memory recovery) > Reborn Krayt.
- Long chain via Vitiate and the Hero of Tython (Novel Vitiate >/~ Revan+Scourge+Meetra; Act 3 HoT >> Vitiate) to inflate SoR Revan; claims SoR Revan one-shots Krayt.

## ILS (Krayt)
- Attacks the stat methodology (inconsistent stats, e.g. Hosk vs Cade healing UTF).
- Chain: Reborn Krayt > Apocalypse Krayt (drained Luke + Abeloth) > Abeloth-tier >> Tenebrae/Echoes of Oblivion Revan > SoR Revan ("SoR Revan is a fraction of EoO Revan"; Abeloth is in a different tier than Tenebrae).
- Conclusion "A Margin of Safety": Krayt > SoR Revan holds even if many parts of his argument are wrong.

## Grok's read
ILS's case is stronger: it runs on an on-page feat (the Abeloth drain) and story framing, while KoB stacks RPG stat numbers and long indirect chains. Matches verdicts.md (Krayt tier 4, Revan tier 5). Verdict: Krayt, medium-high.
